meta.description: Infer large-scale copy-number alterations from tumor single-cell or single-nucleus RNA-seq to separate malignant from normal cells and call subclones, using inferCNV, copyKAT, Numbat, and SCEVAN. Use when separating malignant from normal cells in a tumor scRNA-seq dataset, inferring chromosome-arm CNVs or aneuploidy from expression, calling tumor subclones from single cells, choosing a CNV-inference method, or deciding which cells are tumor before downstream analysis.

methodological_ground.detail: No correlation/causation fallacy or ignored ethical-compliance requirement observed in any output.

code_usability.detail: The inferCNV malignant-calling bug is CONFIRMED FIXED by independent fresh execution (new out_dir, new run, not reusing the fixer's or original auditor's run artifacts). The Numbat df_allele bug is narrowed but NOT fully closed: independent execution against numbat 1.5.2's real check_allele_df() shows it requires an 11th column ('gene') that the fix's documentation still omits (it documents 10). This is the same narrow, single-field data-contract gap class as the original P1 (not a syntax error, infinite loop, or missing dependency), so it remains a P1, not a veto trigger, consistent with the original audit's non-veto reasoning.

inputs.label: SCEVAN reference-free automatic malignant + subclone calling (NEW this round)
inputs.note: NEW input added this round to close the pre-fix audit's zero-SCEVAN-coverage gap, and to verify the fixer's most consequential claim. Ran the shipped examples/scevan_calling.R VERBATIM (unmodified) against two independently-built synthetic panels: (1) a narrow 3-chromosome panel -- reproduced 'all cells are filtered' exactly as the new Common Errors row claims; (2) a fresh, independently-built genome-wide (22-autosome) panel -- pipelineCNA() ran into real classification and subclone segmentation, its internal plotting step then threw 'arguments imply differing number of rows: 0, 70' (matching the documented bug), the tryCatch wrapper caught it and the script completed (exit 0, printed 'SCEVAN complete'). Classification correctness was confirmed from the on-disk tumor1_CNAmtxSubclones.RData side effect (70 columns = exactly all 70 true tumor cells, 0 of the 40 true-normal cells), since the caught error discards the return value as documented.

key_strengths: The inferCNV malignant-calling fix is fully verified: an independent fresh run (new out_dir, not reusing prior artifacts) confirms infercnv.observations.txt is genuinely absent under 1.22's default mode and the corrected readRDS() code reproduces the correct CloneA > CloneB CNV-score ranking exactly.

SCEVAN, previously recommended with zero example code, now has a real, executed example that correctly demonstrates both its documented failure mode (narrow-panel 'all cells are filtered') and its documented workaround (tryCatch around the no-plot=FALSE plotting bug), with classification verified 100% correct against ground truth via on-disk side effects.

The fixer's own SCEVAN caveat (undocumented plotting bug in 1.0.3) reproduced exactly on independently-built synthetic data, including the precise error text -- a rare case of a documented tool defect holding up under a second, independent execution.
Governing-principle and hypothesis-language framing (unaffected by this fix) continues to hold up under adversarial testing with no explicit clinical disclaimer needed.
Assertion pass rate rose from 27/31 (87.1%) to 33/36 (91.7%), clearing the 90% Production Ready floor -- driven by the inferCNV fix and the new, fully-passing SCEVAN input.

recommendations.title: Numbat df_allele docs still miss 1 of 11 required columns ('gene')
recommendations.problem: The fix updated df_allele's documented columns from 7 to 10 (adding cM, REF, ALT), but numbat 1.5.2's real numbat:::check_allele_df() requires an 11th column, 'gene', which is still undocumented in both SKILL.md prose and the parameter reference table. A df_allele built to the exact current spec is still rejected by real validation before any computation runs.
recommendations.root_cause: The fix's verification appears to have checked that cM/REF/ALT (the previously reported error) were fixed, without re-running check_allele_df() against the fully-updated 10-column frame to confirm no further columns were required.
recommendations.fix: Add 'gene' to both the df_allele column list and the parameter reference table row, with a one-line note on where it comes from (gene the SNP falls within, from the same annotation used by pileup_and_phase.R). Verify by calling numbat:::check_allele_df() directly on the final 11-column frame.
